subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Microplastics are tiny plastic particles less than 5 millimeters in size that contaminate marine environments worldwide.
• The Ocean Cleanup Project is an environmental initiative that launched in 2018.
• The project's goal is to remove plastic waste from ocean garbage patches.
• The project uses autonomous collection systems equipped with nets and sensors that can operate in remote ocean areas.
• In 2021, for the first time, the project successfully extracted tons of plastic waste from the Great Pacific Garbage Patch.
prompt: The student wants to present the Ocean Cleanup Project's aim and methodology. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: An environmental initiative designed to remove plastic waste from ocean garbage patches, the Ocean Cleanup Project uses autonomous collection systems equipped with nets and sensors.
choices.B: In 2021, the Ocean Cleanup Project's autonomous systems extracted tons of plastic waste from the Great Pacific Garbage Patch.
choices.C: Though the Ocean Cleanup Project launched in 2018, its autonomous systems didn't successfully extract plastic waste until 2021.
choices.D: To achieve its aims, the Ocean Cleanup Project uses autonomous collection systems equipped with nets and sensors.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. The sentence effectively presents the Ocean Cleanup Project's aim, noting that it is designed to remove plastic waste from ocean garbage patches, and its methodology (it uses autonomous collection systems with nets and sensors).

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect. The sentence describes an achievement from the Ocean Cleanup Project; it doesn't effectively present the project's aim or its methodology.
